result.detail: Vercel docs state no review gate and no install/user cap for unreviewed apps. Unlisted integrations get a Community badge and external users can install them via your site or the deploy button. Review (integrations@vercel.com) and the 500-install threshold apply only to Marketplace listing. Sign in with Vercel apps show users a consent page and mention no review gate. Caveat: one page says to share an integration once it is approved, so the wording is not fully unambiguous. Per-customer access tokens also need no vendor gate.
result.quote: it will be assigned the Community badge and be available for external users to download
